_comment: Models shown by /ar.html. Each entry: id (URL ?m=), glb (required, metres, Y-up), usdz (optional - iOS Quick Look uses it directly, otherwise model-viewer converts the GLB on the fly), placement floor|wall, scale fixed (life-size) | auto. See the repo README for the scan-to-web pipeline.

caption.zh: 溫哥華史丹利公園布羅克頓角的圖騰柱，是加拿大最多人參觀的景點之一。這是 5.6 公尺高的示意模型：熊、人像、渡鴉與雷鳥四層疊起。真正的掃描完成後會換成實物。
caption.en: The totem poles at Brockton Point in Vancouver's Stanley Park are among the most visited sights in Canada. This is a 5.6 m stylised stand-in with four stacked figures: bear, human, raven and thunderbird. It will be replaced by a real scan.

models.credit: Stylised model built in Blender 4.5 on GitHub Actions - not a scan

caption.zh: 溫哥華英吉利灣海濱的因紐特石堆（Inukshuk），1986 年世博會後由西北地區贈予溫哥華，是 2010 冬奧會標誌的原型。這是 6 公尺高的示意模型，以 USDZ 檔放進 scans/ 由 GitHub Actions 自動轉檔登記。真正的掃描完成後會換成實物。
caption.en: The Inukshuk on the English Bay seawall in Vancouver, a gift from the Northwest Territories after Expo 86 and the inspiration for the 2010 Winter Olympics emblem. This is a 6 m stylised stand-in that was dropped into scans/ as a USDZ and converted and registered by GitHub Actions. It will be replaced by a real scan.

models.credit: Stylised stand-in built in Blender 4.5 and pushed through scans/ as a Y-up USDZ - not a scan

caption.zh: 示範模型：一座 2.4 公尺高的石灰岩基座與大理石半身像。真正的景點掃描完成後，只要把掃描檔放進 scans/，GitHub Actions 會自動轉檔並登記，就會在這裡出現。
caption.en: Demo model: a 2.4 m limestone pedestal with a marble bust. Once a real landmark is scanned, drop the scan into scans/ and register it in index.json and it appears here.

models.credit: Procedural demo built in Blender 4.5 - stand-in for an iPhone Object Capture scan
